sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Reject the duplicate and wrongly owned betaIPrime constraint: betaIPrime has canonical requiredOwner ship, so remove it from BowSubregionCalculationCaseShape and retain it only on ShipShape. Also prevent accidental passes caused by the optional hasBowSubregionCalculationCase path: the applicability gate must make an applicable bow-form case discoverable and require its case data, rather than treating absence of the case as non-applicability. Bind sh:hasValue to those exact vocab/unit IRIs for every quantity. Keep the COMPLEX_READINESS boundary: require the declared operands, applicability relationship/value, result, ownership, datatypes, and units, but do not invent D_UI or execute the informational formula.

Candidate faithfully preserves the COMPLEX_READINESS boundary, authoritative ownership, applicability relationship and controlled value, all declared operands and result terms, exact QUDT units, and required datatypes. Deterministic validation is valid and no semantic mismatch remains.
